summary: Comprehensive testing of SB Drive VTC iteration 8 - XJekPlus redesign with new onboarding carousel and login flow. All 23 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend features tested and working correctly including splash screen, 4-slide onboarding carousel, phone login with social modal, home page with all sections, profile page, and chauffeur welcome page.
passed_tests: Splash screen at / shows 'SB Drive' + 'CLIENT APP' text in blue italic font
After 2.2s splash transitions to onboarding carousel
Onboarding has 4 slides with icons: Connexion rapide & sécurisée, Réservez en un clic, Suivi en temps réel, Notifications instantanées
Onboarding has 'Passer' skip button and arrow next button
After 4th slide, shows login choice page with 'Se connecter' and 'Créer un compte' buttons
Login page at /login shows phone input with +33 flag
'Ou choisir d'autres options' opens modal with Google, Email, Face ID/Touch ID options
Email login mode works with test2@example.com / TestPass123!
After login redirects to /home
Home page has search bar 'Rechercher'
Home has promo carousel with 2 banners
Home has Services Taxi section with 8 items: VTC Réservation, VTC Pooling, VTC Location, Chauffeur Privé, Enchères VTC, VTC Intercity, Programmer Course, Plus de Services
Home has Livraison de Colis section (purple gradient)
Home has Services de Livraison section with 4 items: Livraison Repas, Livraison Courses, Livraison Médicaments, Plus de Services
Home has Consultation Vidéo section (teal) with Tuteur, Avocat, Astrologue categories
Home has Services à la demande section with 4 items: Bricolage, Massage, Mécanique, Plus de Services
Dark bottom nav with Accueil (green pill active), Réservations, Portefeuille, Profil
Profile page has green header (#00C853) with avatar, name (Test User 2), email, phone
Profile has wallet balance card with 4 quick actions: Réservations, Portefeuille, Recharger, Inviter
Profile has 8 settings items under 'Paramètres généraux': À propos de vous, Mes réservations, Profil business, Mon panier, Notifications, Prestataires favoris, Inviter des amis, Contacts d'urgence
Logout button works and returns to /
Food page shows 3 restaurants: Burger Palace, Pizza Heaven, Sushi Master
Admin login at /login works with admin@superapp.com / SuperAdmin123! - redirects to /admin dashboard
Chauffeur welcome at /chauffeur shows amber/dark theme with 'SB Drive Chauffeur' branding
All 23 backend API tests passed: health, auth (user/admin/merchant), merchants, rides, orders, wallet, support, admin
